name: Sandless Refinishing: Does It Actually Work? A Renton Reality Check
title-tag: Does Sandless Floor Refinishing Work? Renton, WA Guide
meta-description: Sandless refinishing is really recoating — great for dull floors, useless for scratches into wood. A Renton contractor explains which your floor needs.
post-summary: September 2, 2026 · Sandless refinishing is a recoat with better marketing: it restores dull, intact finishes and cannot fix anything in the wood itself. An honest breakdown for Renton homes — what it fixes, what it seals in forever, and how it compares to a $1.99/sq ft screen and recoat or the full sand.
